# DID Reference - Viessmann Vitocal 262-A

This document lists all Data Identifiers (DIDs) that were found on the heat pump's CAN bus
(address 0x680, module HPMUMASTER) during a scan with
[open3e](https://github.com/open3e/open3e). Raw hex values are snapshots captured at scan time.

The scan files are in [../scan/](../scan/).

---

## Active DIDs (implemented in ESPHome)
